# Third-party code and artwork

- `Microkit/MicroMap/` and `Microkit/Resources/MicroMap/` come from
  [MicroMap](https://github.com/hello-malek/micromap) by Martin Málek, commit `f9ed19e`
  (2026-07-20), under the MIT License (`MicroMap-LICENSE.txt`). Microkit replaced its HID service
  with an adapter over Microkit's engine and added modes, keycode categories and a demo link; the
  changes are marked "Microkit:" in comments.
- The keycap textures, controller renders and shortcut icons in `Microkit/Resources/MicroMap/`
  come from the "Work Louder x Figma" Figma Community file by RobertCulver, under CC BY 4.0
  (details in `MicroMap-NOTICE.md`). Microkit's keycaps (`FigmaKeycap`, drawn from the file's
  "Key" components) and the `ToolIcons/` glyphs come from the same file and license.
  Figma, Work Louder and Creator Micro are trademarks of their
  owners; Microkit is not affiliated with them.
